author: Praxis I
title: BRBG-Dual-AdaptPC-SoftQuota: τ=0.05 (adaptive residualized PCs + soft balanced kNN)
abstract: Single-parameter soft quotas (τ=0.05) for the graph path within Dual BRBG: per-PC adaptive residualization (γ_max=0.74, λ=0.9) then soft balanced kNN (k=48, cosine). Goal: retain mixing while pruning pathological cross-batch edges; τ→0 recovers equal quotas.
